construct: Dictionary meaning fixes the object; varṇa/vṛtti supplies modulation-field, not definition. LLM judges assess whether the real varṇa-derived modulation better fits the fixed object-function than control modulations.
instrument: LLM judge panel (blinded), forced binary choice, objective object-function modulation-fit

judge_wording.primary: Given the dictionary meaning of the object, which option gives a more fitting inner tendency or field around this object without changing what it is?
judge_wording.plain_variant: Which option is more naturally suited to the object's ordinary function?

judge_panel.temperature: deterministic or low, controlled and recorded
judge_panel.rationale: optional, diagnostic-only, never part of scored outcome

primary_endpoint: A_real win-rate vs R_deranged (forced choice) on the primary concrete-object set
primary_endpoint_reason: R_deranged (another object's real varṇa field) tests object-SPECIFICITY vs merely coherent symbolic prose; B1.1/B1.2 found real ~ deranged

semantic_baseline_check.method_a: judge given dictionary anchor + neutral object-function descriptors only, WITHOUT varṇa modulation
semantic_baseline_check.method_b: compare A_real against a simple object-function heuristic baseline derived from the dictionary meaning
semantic_baseline_check.purpose: detect whether the LLM is merely matching ordinary object semantics read off the anchor
semantic_baseline_check.fail_rule: if the dictionary/object-function baseline performs as well as A_real, the Symbol-U-specific claim FAILS

analysis_methods.aggregate: win rates per comparison with confidence intervals
analysis_methods.model: mixed-effects logistic (item + judge random effects) if feasible; win-rate + CI otherwise
analysis_methods.invalid_response_handling: predeclared: unparseable/refused/tie -> predeclared rule; counted, not silently dropped

draft_thresholds.significance_rule: corrected significance or preregistered CI rule
draft_thresholds.note: DRAFT thresholds, revisable until explicit EVIDENCE_FREEZE; NOT evidence-freeze thresholds

success_criteria_all_must_hold: A_real beats or adds beyond the semantic-only/object-function baseline
result holds on primary concrete objects
result not driven by secondary/diagnostic words
result not driven by one LLM judge family
survives multiplicity correction or preregistered CI rule
kill_criteria_any: result appears only in diagnostic/high-confound set
result depends on one judge model only
allowed_future_label_meaning: LLM judges, under fixed dictionary anchors for concrete objects, prefer real varṇa-derived modulation over deranged/scrambled/random/neutral controls for object-function fit; LLM object-fit ceiling only, NOT human/ontology/truth

prior_results_preserved.B1.1: LLM null on earlier mixed/loaded design
